ns2:section.sectionText: A weekend field trip to Dixon Springs in southern Illinois for Sustainablility LLC residents that investigates the environment of Southern Illinois, examining the ecology, geology and sustainability of the region. Activities will include a writing workshop, a tour of Midwestern forests and wetlands, nature photography, and geological hike. The trip occurs October 10-12. Grading will be S/U. The SLLC is subsidizing the transportation costs.
ns2:section.sectionCappArea: Restricted to Sustainability LLC or Unit One students.
